# Room art sources

- Kenney Furniture Kit 2.0: https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit — CC0. Original license included in `KenneyFurniture/License.txt`. Selected original FBX meshes; shared URP colors adapted to the room palette.
- Poly Haven `wood_floor`, Dimitrios Savva: https://polyhaven.com/a/wood_floor — CC0. Original 1K diffuse and OpenGL normal maps; source/license in `PolyHaven/License.txt`.

Prepared with `Fruit Fly Parenting/Art/Prepare Room Assets`. The generated Resources prefabs are installed on all four growth rooms by `RoomArt`; gameplay colliders, item definitions, navigation meshes and scene rig settings are preserved. Architectural meshes are combined by material. The game uses no network requests to load art.
